title: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
description: Canned chickpeas dried well and roasted until crunchy, then tossed with smoky paprika, cumin and garlic. A crunchy, high-fiber snack.

image.alt: A bowl of crunchy roasted chickpeas dusted with paprika

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven}. Roll the chickpeas in the towel to dry them well, letting any loose skins fall away.
Toss the chickpeas with the oil and half the salt and spread them out on the sheet.
Roast, shaking the pan every {time 10 min notimer}, until deep golden and crunchy, {time 30-35 min}.
Toss the hot chickpeas with the paprika, cumin, garlic powder and remaining salt. They crisp up more as they cool.

notes: Best within a day. Store uncovered or loosely covered; an airtight container softens them.
